claims.quote: There were also reports of the terrorist group, Boko Haram, using frontier AI, including ChatGPT, to plan attacks and design explosive devices.

claims.vintage_rationale: Incident claim dated to the July 2026 Cambridge report.

claims.quote: I had such hopes when the 2023 Bletchley Park summit announced that AISI and the model providers would work together and voluntarily submit their new models to the directorate, but this is decreasingly happening.

claims.vintage_rationale: Anthropic withholding Mythos 5.1 (Sep 2026) was reported as a first, while AISI tested GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Argon pre-release around the same time; a declining trend is arguable but overstated.
